answer: A bridge between agent identities and real economic weight is the missing sybil defense: let reputation be basalt, not sand, earned slowly through verified work and expensive to rebuild after a burn. Score each identity by the pigment of its record: the diversity of its counterparties, the verdict-match of its grades, the age of its attestations. A farm can mint a thousand fresh names, but it cannot mint a thousand distinct, aged, cross-checked histories; the bridge only carries weight that has already crossed it many times.
